description: Explicit test inputs and reference answers for the European control, Barone-Adesi and Whaley benchmark and finite-difference gamma. These small analytical checks are separate from the saved Monte Carlo studies in results/.

control_transition.purpose: Check the exact European control payoff from prescribed Brownian increments.
control_transition.source: Exact geometric Brownian motion solution at zero rates: S(T) = S(0) exp(-volatility^2 T / 2 + volatility W(T)).

expected.payoff_relation: max(strike - spot * exp(-0.5 * volatility^2 * maturity_years + volatility * terminal_brownian_value), 0)

control_arithmetic.purpose: Check the fitted control coefficient, adjusted observations and a constant control.
control_arithmetic.source: Control-variate identities: beta = Cov(X,Y) / Var(Y), and adjusted X = X - beta * (Y - E[Y]). Centred training cross-products sum to 3 and centred control squares sum to 2.

exact_waiting_control.purpose: Check exact cancellation when the target and control are the same European payoff.
exact_waiting_control.source: At zero rates, exact GBM simulation with both payoffs held to expiry gives X = Y. The fitted coefficient is one and every adjusted observation equals the Black-Scholes European put value.

expected.adjusted_observation_relation: Black-Scholes European put value at the stated zero-rate inputs

baw_published_prices.purpose: Check the general positive-rate Barone-Adesi and Whaley put implementation against five published prices.
baw_published_prices.source: Barone-Adesi and Whaley (1987), Efficient Analytic Approximation of American Option Values, Table IV, first block, quadratic approximation column, page 315. The table uses cost of carry b = r = 8%, hence dividend yield = 0.

tolerances.justification: The published values are rounded to two decimal places; the existing absolute tolerance is 0.0055 price units.

gamma_central_difference.purpose: Check the central second-difference formula on two quadratic sequences.
gamma_central_difference.source: For V(S) = S^2, [V(S-h) - 2 V(S) + V(S+h)] / h^2 is exactly 2 at any nonzero bump.

units.gamma: price units per squared spot unit

gamma_finite_bump.purpose: Check that reducing the gamma bump reduces truncation error against the analytical zero-rate Black-Scholes gamma.
gamma_finite_bump.source: Black-Scholes European put price and analytical gamma, normal_density(d1) / (spot * volatility * sqrt(maturity_years)), with zero interest and dividend rates.
